content: Definition of configurable interface ProtectionHook Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11013 Service Name ProtectionHook Syntax ProtectionReturnType ProtectionHook ( StatusType Fatalerror ) Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Fatalerror The error which caused the call to the protection hook Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value ProtectionReturnType PRO_IGNORE PRO_TERMINATETASKISR PRO_TERMINATEAPPL PRO_SHUTDOWN The return value defines the action the OS shall take after the protection hook. Description The protection hook is always called if a serious error occurs. E.g. exceeding the worst case execution time or violating against the memory protection. Available via Os_Externals.h
